'''Eric Lanz''' (forums handle '''elanz''') is a volunteer of the [[Players Committee]]. The Players Committee organization chart of 6 May 2024 lists Eric Lanz as Epic Duel Developer (&ldquo;New GEMP UI&rdquo;) in the infrastructure and apps group, under the Rules Advocate [[Greg Zinn]].<ref name="chart">PC Organization Chart, [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback Machine capture of 10 October 2026] of [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (PDF creation date 6 May 2024).</ref> See [[Players Committee organization]].
